global_dichotomy.statement: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group carrying the discrete measurable structure. Let $A, C \subseteq G$ with $A$ nonempty, let $\gamma, \varepsilon \in \mathbb{R}$ with $0 < \gamma \le \operatorname{dens}(C)$, and suppose $\varepsilon \le \left| |G|\,\langle \mu_A * \mu_A, \mu_C\rangle - 1 \right|$ (real inner product). Then $\dfrac{\varepsilon}{2|G|} \le \|\operatorname{bal}(\mu_A) \circ \operatorname{bal}(\mu_A)\|_{p, \mu_G}$, where $p = 2\lceil 1 + \log \gamma^{-1}\rceil$ (natural-number ceiling), $\operatorname{bal}(f) = f - \mathbb{E} f$ is the balanced function, $\circ$ is the discrete difference convolution, and $\|\cdot\|_{p,\mu_G}$ is the $L^p$ norm weighted by the uniform density $\mu_G$ on $G$.
